tutorial.clans: LEDA is an asymmetric duel: each player embodies an animal clan, with their own cards and their own way to win. Here, you play the Pandas, and your opponent the Sharks.
tutorial.victory-condition: This is your Victory Condition card. It reminds you of your 2 ways to win the game: the clan victory, having your {gold} Pandas in play, and the military victory, gathering {victory} . We will come back to that.
tutorial.grid: This is your action grid, 16 tiles in a 4x4 layout. Each round, you will activate 4 spaces of it.
tutorial.action-tile: This is the Action tile of the round. It indicates the zones of 4 spaces the active player has to choose from.
tutorial.choose-zone: You are the active player. This tile lets you activate row 1, column 1 or the top-left square. Your opponent will then activate the same zone in their own grid.
tutorial.activate-order: The zone is chosen: the active player now activates their 4 spaces, in any order they choose.
tutorial.temporary-food: This tile gives 1 , and it is a temporary tile. Activate it.
tutorial.desert: A temporary tile is flipped as soon as it is activated: it becomes a Desert, a side that no longer produces anything.
tutorial.food-stock: Your Food is stored here, and its total is shown in your player panel. Your Clan starts the game with 1 <food/>.
tutorial.food-use: Food is used to play the cards in your hand. Each of these 2 cards will cost you 5 .
tutorial.temporary-upgrade: This tile lets you Upgrade one of your permanent tiles. Activate it.
tutorial.upgrade-target: Upgrade this tile: it will be flipped to its upgraded side, which is more powerful.
tutorial.military-tile: This tile gives 1 Military symbol . Activate it.
tutorial.opponent-activates: Your opponent activates the same 4 spaces in turn, in their own grid.
tutorial.conflict-start: The Activation phase is over. Time for the 2nd phase: the Military Conflict.
tutorial.conflict-rule: The player who gathered the most <military/> symbols during the activation wins the conflict. In case of a tie, nobody gains anything.
tutorial.conflict-won: You obtained 1 and your opponent none: you therefore draw the top Military Victory token and resolve its effect.
tutorial.token: A token always gives at least 1 <victory/>, and often a bonus on top of it. This one also makes you gain 1 <food/>.
tutorial.military-victory: As soon as you control {count} , you immediately win the game!
tutorial.organisation-start: The Military Conflict is settled. Time for the 3rd and last phase of the round: the Organization.
tutorial.organisation-rule: One after the other, the players choose an action: play a card from their hand onto a space of their grid, or swap the position of 2 spaces and gain 1 . Taking that Food without swapping anything is allowed.
tutorial.your-organisation: You have 5 <food/>: you can therefore play a card, for example on one of your Deserts. You can also swap 2 spaces and gain 1 <food/>. Your choice!
tutorial.opponent-organisation: Your opponent organizes their grid in turn.
tutorial.new-round: The 1st round is over. A new round begins, with a new Action tile.
tutorial.opponent-chooses: The players are active in turn: this time, your opponent is the one who chooses the zone to activate.
tutorial.row-chosen: Your opponent chose to activate row 4: you must therefore activate these 4 spaces.
tutorial.draw: This tile makes you draw 1 card, then flips to its Desert side.
tutorial.special-activation: This tile bears a crystal : it triggers the Special Activation of your clan, which is not the same from one clan to another.
tutorial.shark-activation: For your opponent, who plays the Sharks, a crystal <special/> gives 2 <military/>.
tutorial.panda-activation: For you, a crystal gives 1 or 1 Awakening effect.
tutorial.clan-victory: Your clan victory requires your {gold} Pandas in play. You already have the King in hand, and the Queen is waiting for you in your deck: you will also need Pandas, and at least {awakenings} Awakening effects .
tutorial.end: As soon as you meet your clan victory condition, or reach the military victory, the game stops and you win!
tutorial.good-luck: It is your turn to play now. Good luck!

note.awakening: <awakening/> Awakening effect: if you have at least {count} <bronze/> in play, put one of them back into your hand and replace it with a <silver/>; or if you have at least {count} <silver/> in play, put one of them back into your hand and replace it with a <gold/>, in the same space. The Awakening effect is resolved after all the other activations have been resolved.
note.rotation: Rotate: after its activation, the card is turned 180°. Its other effect is then the one that can be activated.
note.ring: As soon as its condition is met, a Ring is played for free, without costing an action, once all the other activations are resolved. Playing 3 Rings wins the game.
note.pack: The PACK effect replaces the normal effect as long as the card is orthogonally adjacent to 2 Shark tokens.
note.portal: Placing the 4 Portals in the 4 corners of your action grid wins the game.
note.desert: A Desert is a temporary tile flipped to its back side.
note.permanent: A permanent tile can always be activated. An Upgrade <upgrade/> effect flips it to its back side, where it will be more powerful in future activations.
note.temporary: A temporary tile becomes a Desert as soon as it is activated. A Flip <flip/> effect turns it back to its front side, where it can be activated again.
note.conflict: At the end of each round, the player who gathered the most military symbols <military/> draws the top token of the pile and resolves its effect. In case of a tie, nobody draws it.
note.clan-victory: The {clan} clan wins if it has {count} <victory/>.
note.special-activation: The crystal <special/> printed on a tile or a card triggers the Special Activation of your clan, which is not the same from one clan to another.
note.action: At the start of the round, the active player reveals the top tile of the pile and chooses one of the zones it indicates. Both players then activate the 4 spaces of that zone in their own grid, the active player first.
note.once-per-activation: The same tile or the same card cannot be activated twice during the Activation phase, even if it changes space in the meantime.
note.cycle: After the {count}th tile revealed, only one is left in the pile: all 5 are reshuffled face down, and the player who controls the fewest <victory/> symbols becomes the new active player.
note.certain-squares: The top-left space (Action tile {first}) and the bottom-right space (Action tile {last}) are guaranteed to be activated when their Action tile is revealed, whether you are the active player or not.
note.shark-victory: Having your {count} Shark tokens in play wins the game.
note.food-gain: You gain some with your tiles and your cards, and during the organization: swapping the position of 2 of your spaces gains 1 <food/>, and you may take it without swapping.

round.title: How a round unfolds
round.activation-text: The active player reveals the top Action tile and chooses one of the zones of 4 spaces it indicates. Each player then activates that zone in their own grid, the active player first. Clan special activations are resolved after all the others.
round.conflict-text: The player who gathered the most <military/> symbols during the activation draws the top Military Victory token and resolves its effect. In case of a tie, nobody draws it.
round.organisation-text: One after the other, the active player then their opponent choose an action: play a card from their hand onto a space of their grid, or swap the position of 2 of their spaces and gain 1 <food/>.
round.next: The next round opens with the other player as the active player.
